subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>, Samir Patel <samir@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps

Hi Laura / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. As promised, attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focusing on the load/perf milestone so we can get a sizing decision tied to dedicated capacity before the end of the quarter. High-level recap below and explicit asks to keep momentum.

Summary (call highlights):
- Goal: run traffic replay (peak QPS) to validate performance and finalize Dedicated capacity sizing for production.
- Success criteria: stable 99th pct latency < 300ms at target peak QPS; error rate < 0.5% during peak window.
- Suggested test window: Oct 26–27 (2-day window) or alternate: Nov 2–3.

MAP milestone (load/perf test) — draft responsibilities:
- FinTechCo: provide representative replay artifacts (S3 path or transfer), list of peak time windows, expected peak QPS by endpoint, and contacts for network/IP allowlist.
- Redwood: provide test plan & harness (attached), reserve Dedicated capacity for agreed peak QPS, run traffic replay, capture logs/metrics, and produce results deck.
- Target close date for sizing decision: 2026-11-10 (to align with Nov billing cycle).
- Dependencies: access to replay data, firewall/IP allowlist, replay script compatibility, and a short smoke run 48h prior.

Action items for you to confirm:
1) Which of the two windows (Oct 26–27 or Nov 2–3) works better?
2) Can you share S3 paths or a small sample replay (1 hour) by Oct 20?
3) Who from your DevOps should we loop in for IP allowlist?

Attachments: MAP-draft-20261015.pdf, load-test-plan.xlsx (test matrix, metrics we collect).

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the plan. We’ll coordinate with Aditya/Vivek on sizing once we have your replay artifact and target QPS.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

---
Redwood Inference — MAP (draft) attached.

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Nov 2–3 would actually work better for us (we have a major release the week of Oct 26).

Couple quick Qs from our side:
- We can provide replay files from our S3 bucket (us-west-2). Is Redwood able to run the replay directly from our S3 or do we need to transfer files to a temporary bucket?
- Peak QPS: we typically see 1.2k QPS across the chat endpoints during peak. Can you confirm what dedicated capacity you’d recommend for that range?
- Cost: will reserving Dedicated capacity for the test incur any additional one-time fees?

I’ll loop in our DevOps lead (Samir on cc) to start the IP allowlist conversation. We can share a 1-hour sample by Oct 20.

Laura Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechCo
laura.chen@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps — need sizing + capacity reserve

Aditya / Vivek — forwarding the customer reply. FinTechCo prefers Nov 2–3. They can provide a 1-hour sample by Oct 20 and report peak QPS ~1.2k.

Can you please:
- Recommend Dedicated capacity sizing to handle sustained 1.2k QPS with our target latencies (99th < 300ms). Include a brief justification (GPUs, batch size, kv cache considerations).
- Confirm whether we can run the replay directly from customer S3 (us-west-2) or if we should ask them to share to a temporary Redwood bucket. Note any network/egress steps and expected time to set up allowlist.
- Tentatively reserve capacity for Nov 2–3 (we can finalize when we have exact replay artifacts).

Attached: sizing_workbook_aditya.xlsx (blank template) and load-test-plan.xlsx.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps — need sizing + capacity reserve

Marissa — thanks for the details. Quick answers (high level):

1) Sizing recommendation (prelim):
- Target sustained peak: 1.2k QPS across chat endpoints. Assuming ~40 tokens average per request and model = redwood-30b-quant (customer indicated accuracy tolerance), we should reserve a 4-GPU dedicated Pod (A100 class or equivalent) with mps-friendly kernel selection and aggressive batching. This gives headroom for KV cache and spikes.
- If they can accept a quantized 16-bit variant or smaller model, we could drop to 3 GPUs. I’ll quantify expected token/sec and cost delta in the workbook.

2) S3 replay:
- We can read directly from customer S3 provided they grant a temporary cross-account role or presigned URLs. Preferred: they upload the sample to a temporary Redwood bucket for speed and to avoid cross-account setup during the window. Either works; presigned URLs are simplest but we prefer a short-lived role for the full run.

3) Network/allowlist:
- Need their DevOps to open outbound to our test IP range and/or provide an allowlist for our nodes. DocuSign link (allowlist form) in the MAP-related links — we usually need 48–72h lead time once we have the IPs.

I’ve populated the sizing_workbook_aditya.xlsx with rough token/sec, estimated GPU util, and cost per hour. Attached. I’ll tentatively reserve 4 GPUs for Nov 2–3 and update if the sample shows lower token density.

—Aditya
Senior Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@fintechco.com>, Samir Patel <samir@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load test scheduling & next steps

Laura / Samir — thanks for confirming Nov 2–3.

Next steps:
- You: share 1-hour sample to S3 (us-west-2) by Oct 20. Presigned URL is fine; if you prefer cross-account role we can set that up but it takes longer.
- FinTechCo DevOps: please complete the allowlist form (DocuSign link below) and we'll provide IPs within 24h of submission.
- Redwood: Aditya has tentatively reserved a 4-GPU pod for Nov 2–3. We’ll run a 30-min smoke run 48h before the main window and share a test checklist.

I’ve attached an updated MAP draft including the Nov 2–3 test window and responsibilities. Once we receive the sample and confirm IP allowlist, we’ll lock the capacity and confirm the final MAP milestone target of 2026-11-10.
